chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid al-Khazzaz, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn A'yan, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was in the house of Umm Salamah, and with him was Jibril (peace be upon him). Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) entered upon them. Jibril said to him, 'Verily, your nation will kill this son of yours. Shall I not show you some of the dust of the earth upon which he will be killed?' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes.' So Jibril (peace be upon him) inclined his hand and took a handful of it, and showed it to the Prophet (peace be upon him).

key_terms.أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ: Umm Salamah, wife of the Prophet
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ: Husayn ibn Ali, grandson of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did Jibril show the Prophet regarding Husayn's martyrdom?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the prophetic foreknowledge of the tragedy of Karbala, specifically linking the martyrdom of Imam Husayn (a.s.) to the broader Muslim *Ummah* rather than just the Quraysh. It serves as a foundational text for the concept of *Turbat al-Shuhada*, where the dust of the battlefield is revered as a medium for spiritual connection and intercession. The inclusion of this event in ziyarat literature underscores the theological significance of Husayn's sacrifice as a pivotal moment in Islamic history.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn Walīd Al-Khazzāz, from Ḥammād ibn ‘Uthmān, from ‘Abdil Malik ibn A’yan, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say: (One day) when Jabra`īl was with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) in the house of Um Salamah, Ḥusain (a.s.) entered. Jabra`īl said, “Verily your nation will kill this son of yours. Should I not show you the dust of the land on which he will be killed?” The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) replied, “Yes.” Therefore, Jabra`īl extended his hand (to the land on which Ḥusain (a.s.) would be killed), took a handful of that dust, and then showed it to the Prophet (s.a.a.w.)
